response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience in software development and geospatial projects (e.g., GISCollective), demonstrating strong problem-solving and system design skills. However, his primary expertise lies in languages like TypeScript, JavaScript, and D, with limited direct experience in C++ or Rust, which are core requirements for the role. His background in high-performance systems (e.g., low-latency apps at Dunnhumby) is promising but not fully aligned with the routing tiling pipeline focus.
strengths: Strong geospatial data processing experience (GISCollective, Open Green Map)
Proven ability to build and optimize high-performance systems (Dunnhumby, Sociomantic)
Experience with distributed systems and DevOps practices (CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker)
concerns: Limited direct experience with C++ or Rust, the primary technologies required for this role
No explicit mention of navigation systems or routing data pipelines in prior work
Primary expertise in web/mobile development (TypeScript, JavaScript) rather than backend systems
